answer: La Tarde en la Junta Vecinal

word: An unfriendly neighbor complains about the noise.

word: A polite resident offers a calm explanation.
answer: Un residente educado ofrece una explicación tranquila.

word: A rude comment escalates the tension quickly.
answer: Un comentario grosero eleva la tensión rápidamente.

word: A generous volunteer brings snacks for everyone.
answer: Un voluntario generoso trae botanas para todos.

answer: Un miembro tacaño se niega a aportar algo.

word: A selfish attitude disrupts the planned agenda.
answer: Una actitud egoísta interrumpe la agenda planeada.

word: A humble suggestion softens the heated debate.

word: An arrogant remark reignites the argument.

answer: Un vecino celoso cuestiona la nueva propuesta.

word: An envious resident criticizes the improvements.

word: A calm voice restores order in seconds.

word: A violent outburst shocks the entire room.

word: A peaceful pause helps everyone breathe.
answer: Una pausa pacífica ayuda a todos a respirar.

word: A loving gesture comforts the upset child.
answer: Un gesto amoroso consuela al niño molesto.

word: A caring neighbor offers to walk her home.
answer: Un vecino cariñoso ofrece acompañarla a casa.

word: We are going to report the mean behavior.

word: A nice suggestion redirects the conversation.
